fixture_first_record.behavior: The locked full-surface fixture and both rejection inputs were authored before opening the staged historical NIM fixture. It composes public DMA buffer and DCT admission IR with interrupt-owned dispatch and deferred-work-owned packet service.

transplants.source_scope: Driver-keyed table, ordered serialization, and trait-override recognition idioms only; no old two-operation schema or diagnostic was copied.
transplants.old_semantics: The historical model recognized only Network::open and Network::stop and had no packet, carrier, property, counter, publication, or observer plane.
transplants.new_semantics: One driver-keyed NetworkInterface element records the full frozen admin, opaque packet, state, property, counter, and optional observer operation set as InstanceRefs.
transplants.behavior_delta: Drivers engaged by implementing NetworkInterface must override the required locked core; a network class tag alone does not engage NIM admission, while the old open/stop trait and incomplete engaged implementations reject. Optional operations remain None instead of succeeding implicitly. Whole-driver completeness is deferred to the C50/E3 composition gate, where the rich E1000 model must contain its network_interface entry with every required operation resolved and each optional capability implemented or explicitly absent.
transplants.reuse_mode: adapted structural idioms; locked model and recognizer re-authored

transplants.source_scope: PCI net_device allocation/registration, netdev_ops, ISR-wrapper, and private-container idioms; the historical open/stop-only scope and shared-line-only policy were excluded.
transplants.old_semantics: Linux emitted netdev publication and open/stop only; ndo_start_xmit, RX, carrier, counters, MTU/MAC/filter hooks, packet ownership, DMA mapping, descriptors, and indices were explicitly out of scope.
transplants.new_semantics: Linux emits the complete frozen NIM binding plus backend-private descriptor/index/DMA packet ownership state while existing IRQ and deferred-work tables retain dispatch and drain ownership.
transplants.behavior_delta: Busy retains the skb, accepted packets are mapped and reclaimed, initialization precedes registration, and orderly removal drains work then masks/frees IRQ before unregistering and freeing packet state; no terminal packet event is invented.
transplants.reuse_mode: adapted native Linux scaffold idioms; full binding and lifecycle composition re-authored

oracle_only.disposition: Opened only after the locked fixtures and tests existed; the historical input, golden, conformance file, and test structure were not copied and serve only as the open/stop comparison oracle.
Not transplanted; packet mapping and descriptor state are backend-private, and the public frozen DMA buffer plus DCT admission tables are consumed unchanged.

rejected_assets.disposition: Rejected: no merge, cherry-pick, whole-file restore, historical coverage claim, or unrelated serial/DMA edit.
